_readme: Cases for scripts/eval_cues.py. Copy this to ~/.second_brain/eval_cases.json
and replace with your own — the real file stays out of the repo because it
Each top-level key is a named SET. Keep at least one you never tune cues
against, and quote that one: a set you can see while editing cues will score
near 100% and tell you nothing about phrasings you have not thought of.
'query' is what a person would plausibly type. 'expect' is the node id that
must come back — copy it from `graph.py list --type rule`, since ids are
truncated to 48 characters and are easy to mistype (the runner checks).

rules.query: this is a two minute job, I will do it Friday
log that I am blocked waiting on someone

skills.query: what should I work on today

rules.query: trivial change, I'll batch it with the rest on Monday
mark this blocked, she owes me an answer
